claim: The police are getting younger is explained through different sets of people at different times.
evidence_summary: A stable force could have a falling mean age as membership changes.
finding: A theory of what the NP picks out is needed to choose between an institutional and a member-set analysis.
inference: Does change in the members compared over time require a change of institutional referent?

evidence.passage: §8.3, p. 406. The police are getting younger is explained through different sets of people at different times.
evidence.example: Compare a police force whose older members retire and whose younger recruits replace them. The sets of people compared change even if speakers identify the same continuing institution at every date.
evidence.establishes: Both descriptions can be true in the same history. A model of the referent is needed to distinguish readings of The police are getting younger.
evidence.locator: The difference between possible variation and actual variation
evidence.note: Local source (working note, unpublished draft or local copy); not online.
